breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the contribution of the average normal stress to the in-plane shear state; the maximum in-plane shear depends on both σ_avg and τ_avg.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly includes the combined maximum in-plane shear formula τ_max = sqrt((σ_avg/2)^2 + τ_avg^2), which accounts for both average normal stress and average shear stress. It also omits the incorrect instruction that maximum in-plane shear should be taken as shear stress alone.
